Class ScaleManager

java.lang.Object
core.ScaleManager
public class ScaleManager extends Object
A static utility class designed to handle application scaling and positioning.

This manager ensures that the application maintains its aspect ratio and fits properly on screens with varying resolutions or DPI settings (e.g., Windows scaling at 150%). It operates based on a fixed design resolution and scales JavaFX nodes accordingly.

  • Method Details

    • init

      public static void init(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Calculates the appropriate scale factor based on the primary screen's available visual bounds. The scale is calculated to ensure the application fits within the screen while maintaining its design aspect ratio.
      Parameters:
      stage - The primary stage of the application.

    • applyScale

      public static void applyScale(javafx.scene.Parent root)
      Applies the calculated scale factor to a JavaFX Parent node.

      If the root is a Region, its preferred size is strictly set to the design dimensions. To prevent unexpected resizing behavior from the Scene, the root is wrapped in an unresizable Group if it is currently the root of the scene.

      Parameters:
      root - The root node to which the scaling transformation should be applied.

    • getScale

      public static double getScale()
      Retrieves the current scale factor being applied to the application.
      Returns:
      The uniform scale factor as a double.

    • centerStage

      public static void centerStage(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Centers the provided stage on the primary screen based on its visual bounds.
      Parameters:
      stage - The JavaFX Stage to be centered.

    • resizeAndCenter

      public static void resizeAndCenter(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Resizes the stage to match its scene's dimensions and then centers it on the screen.

      This utility method should typically be called after setting a new scene (e.g., immediately after stage.setScene(...)).

      Parameters:
      stage - The JavaFX Stage to resize and center.
